name: Editorial image panels
description: Make a premium sound-off ad from a small asset set. Builds an editable 12-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 12 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: One strong image and a headline open the ad. The image comes back with your promise.

props.text: Your strongest image. It opens and closes the ad.

props.label: Promise
props.hint: Shows when the main image comes back.

props.subtitle: Each panel adds one image and one line to the grid.
The main image holds with a clear next step.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

creativeStrategy.objective: Make a premium sound-off ad from a small asset set.
creativeStrategy.direction: A deliberate grid and stable type do most of the work; motion reveals one panel at a time.

shots.title: Headline sits beside or above a single strong image.

fallback.prompt: An editorial photograph of the hero subject in its best light, for the line "{headline}". Natural light, one clear focal point, room to crop. No text, letters, logos or faces.

elements.direction: Image wipes on over 350 ms; type already readable.

shots.title: Second image creates a two-panel composition.

fallback.prompt: An editorial photograph of the hero subject in its best light, for the line "{headline}". Natural light, one clear focal point, room to crop. No text, letters, logos or faces.
An editorial photograph of a close detail of the subject, for the line "{benefit1}". Natural light, one clear focal point, room to crop. No text, letters, logos or faces.

elements.direction: Push first panel into its final grid position; reveal second.

reviewRules: Image subject remains inside its crop.

shots.title: Third image completes the grid.

fallback.prompt: An editorial photograph of the hero subject in its best light, for the line "{headline}". Natural light, one clear focal point, room to crop. No text, letters, logos or faces.
An editorial photograph of a close detail of the subject, for the line "{benefit1}". Natural light, one clear focal point, room to crop. No text, letters, logos or faces.
An editorial photograph of the subject in use, in its setting, for the line "{benefit2}". Natural light, one clear focal point, room to crop. No text, letters, logos or faces.

elements.direction: 250 ms wipe; no independent zoom on every panel.

reviewRules: Panel edges align with the previous cut.

shots.title: Return to the strongest image with a short promise.

fallback.prompt: An editorial photograph of the hero subject in its best light, for the line "{headline}". Natural light, one clear focal point, room to crop. No text, letters, logos or faces.

elements.direction: Expand one panel while others exit; use a parent group.

shots.title: Hero image plus clear next step.

fallback.prompt: An editorial photograph of the hero subject in its best light, for the line "{headline}". Natural light, one clear focal point, room to crop. No text, letters, logos or faces.

reviewRules: The final brand and CTA are fully settled and readable.
Panel edges align consistently across cuts.
Images remain sharp at their largest displayed crop.

value.title: Editorial image panels
value.objective: Make a premium sound-off ad from a small asset set.
value.direction: A deliberate grid and stable type do most of the work; motion reveals one panel at a time.
beats: 0–2 s: Headline sits beside or above a single strong image. Shows Brand color, Main image, Headline.
2–4.5 s: Second image creates a two-panel composition. Shows Brand color, Main image, Panel 2, Panel 2 line.
4.5–7 s: Third image completes the grid. Shows Brand color, Main image, Panel 2, Panel 3, Panel 3 line.
7–9.5 s: Return to the strongest image with a short promise. Shows Brand color, Main image, Promise.
9.5–12 s: Hero image plus clear next step. Shows Brand color, Main image, , Logo, Call to action.

images.label: Main image
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Third image completes the grid.

images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Hero image plus clear next step.
